name: Shezmu permissionless collateral mint
summary: A WBTC collateral input token exposed mint(address,uint256) without caller authorization. The attacker minted arbitrary collateral, deposited it into the vault, and borrowed unbacked ShezUSD.
notes: The permissionless mint path is part of the token's immutable direct runtime, deployed in this transaction and unchanged through the exploit.

Two receipts in the bounded seven-nonce campaign depleted the ShezUSD/USDC pool by exactly 639,740.960319 + 42,926.569474 = 682,667.529793 USDC, with no campaign USDC input or return. The first receipt's same-block MEV transaction returned 76,500.771328 USDC to the pool while removing 122,736.557154824572663770 ShezUSD; those unrelated flows explain the block-level archive residual and are excluded from this campaign. The attacker-created 18-decimal pseudo-WBTC and freshly issued ShezUSD are unbacked consideration retained by the protocol or pool, not additional priceable victim outflows. Downstream WETH/ETH disposal and later negotiated recovery are excluded from exploit-time gross loss. Same-day recurrence by a second actor (USDC and sDAI components): Four disposal receipts depleted the Curve ShezUSD/USDC pool by 962.224781 + 118.616729 + 142.949383 = 1,223.790893 USDC and the Balancer ShezUSD/sDAI pool by 771.270672279107347817 + 92.720177612173316782 = 863.990849891280664599 sDAI. Each receipt exactly matches the corresponding archive pool-balance delta, with no same-block residual. The two sDAI components are valued at their closest-preceding ERC-4626 DAI conversion values and DAI par. The freely minted pseudo-WBTC and ShezUSD are unbacked pool consideration, not additional scarce-asset loss. Downstream WETH/ETH disposal, retained unbacked ShezUSD, and later return activity are excluded.

A second, unrelated actor repeated the exploit three hours later (transaction 0x39328ea4377a8887d3f6ce91b2f4c6b19a851e2fc5163e2f83bbc2fc136d0c71); that recurrence is merged here as the 1223.79 USDC and 863.99 sDAI components.
